metadata.case_name: TSAI SHIH CHIEH v. MOK SIU FAI

plaintiff.occupation_before: long term casual construction site worker
plaintiff.occupation_after: casual construction site worker (employed on average 8 or 9 days a month)

source: He was found to be slightly confused with a Glasgow Coma Scale of 13/15
Dr Woo commented that the complaints of headaches, dizziness, impaired memory and concentration were all consistent with a diagnosis of post-concussional syndrome.

injuries.description: deep facial lacerations and resultant facial scarring
source: There were deep lacerations all over his face, including those at the left eyebrow, the upper lip and gum. Debridgement and suturing was done.
Dr Chiang reported that facial scar between the plaintiff's left upper lip and nostril was visible but faint.

injuries.description: hairline fracture of the right fibula
source: His right fibula suffered a hairline fracture.
From the X-rays Dr Chiang found that the fracture of the right fibula had united;

injuries.description: loosening of the upper incisors (upper 1st and 2nd incisors)
source: an upper incisor tooth was found to be loose.
loosening of the upper 1st and 2nd incisors;

injuries.description: injury to right patella / right knee (patella symptoms)
source: Dr Chiang's findings regarding the injury to the right knee were : no soft tissue swelling and no tenderness at the fibula fracture area; gait was normal, and thigh and calf circumferences were equal; right patella stress test and grinding test elicited some pain; some tenderness in the fracture area on palpitation; flexion and extension were equal for both knees; power tests for both knees were normal.
He advised a course of physiotherapy treatments to stretch and strengthen the quadriceps, and advised ultrasound treatment of the plaintiff's injured right patella.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of other specified muscle, fascia, tendon or bursa at lower leg level

manifestations.description: bifrontal and bitemporal headaches which would sometimes last for hours, and on occasion for days
memory and concentration were impaired; memory lapses sometimes resulted in reprimands from his superiors at work
has become irritable and short tempered
an upper incisor tooth was found to be loose; loosening of the upper 1st and 2nd incisors
pain in the right knee after 1 1/2 hours of walking; pain whenever he squats; pain on rainy days; pain when heavy objects over 20 lbs are lifted
inability of climbing on to scaffolding
a faint but unsightly scar by his eyebrow and another one near his nose

treatments_received: hospital admission (Queen Mary Hospital, transfer to Tung Wah Hospital, discharge from Kwong Wah Hospital)
outpatient treatment at the Sai Ying Pun Clinic
6 sessions of treatment at the outpatients' orthopaedic department (Pamela Youde Nethersole Eastern Hospital)
treatments_future: ultrasound treatment of the plaintiff's injured right patella

losses.description: His knee hurts whenever he walks long distances; he cannot squat or climb scaffolding any more.
There is a faint but unsightly scar by his eyebrow and another one near his nose.
Loosening of the upper 1st and 2nd incisors / an upper incisor tooth was found to be loose.
He has become irritable and short tempered unlike before.
Episodes of dizziness and vertigo causing need to stop work.
